fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Keep the path between the main residence and detached structure clear of parked vehicles and equipment.
• Trim vegetation growing close to the detached structure to allow responders to move around all sides.
• Mark or identify rear access points so responders arriving on scene can locate them without searching.
• Keep any gates providing rear access unlocked or secured with a method that allows quick entry by responders.
• Remove any obstacles from the walkway connecting the front driveway to the main entrance.
• Maintain the open lawn area free of stored materials so responders can use it for staging or equipment placement.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that hang directly over or touch the house and any attached structures.
• Thin the tree cluster nearest to the house to create open space between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against the base of the house.
• Clear low-hanging branches from trees along the driveway to keep the travel lane open for vehicles.
• Trim shrubs and tall grass along the driveway edges that could block or narrow vehicle passage.
• Keep the single access route clear of fallen branches, overgrown vegetation, and other debris year-round.
• Separate any shrubs growing beneath trees so fire cannot move from ground-level plants up into the tree canopy.
• Remove dead branches and dry plant material from shrubs near the house and outbuildings.
• Thin scattered shrubs on the uphill or windward side of the house more aggressively than those on other sides.
• Keep the area immediately surrounding the house mowed short and free of dry plant material during dry months.
